questions.question: Who is currently 3rd from top of the Premier League table today, Thursday, 19th Nov 2026?
questions.clue: The reigning powerhouse club that plays its home matches at the Etihad Stadium.
questions.funFact: They sit on 21 points from their opening 10 fixtures, just one point behind second-placed Brighton.

questions.question: Who is the new manager of Manchester United?
questions.clue: A former Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea manager who took over the Old Trafford hot seat in November 2026.
questions.funFact: The experienced Argentine coach previously managed Tottenham Hotspur, Southampton, and Chelsea in the Premier League.

questions.question: Who is the new manager of Crystal Palace?
questions.clue: A charismatic Danish manager who stepped into the Selhurst Park dugout following Pierre Sage's departure.
questions.funFact: The Danish tactician earned widespread acclaim in English football during his successful spell transforming Brentford into an established Premier League club.

questions.question: Which ex-Manchester United French defender celebrates his birthday today? (61)
questions.clue: A tall, elegant French World Cup-winning center-back who joined Manchester United in 2001.
questions.funFact: Nicknamed "Le Président," he scored the first-ever Golden Goal in FIFA World Cup history for France in 1998.

questions.question: Two of the bottom three teams in the Premier League have new managers (Crystal Palace & Man U); which other team is in the relegation zone?
questions.clue: This Wearside club plays its home matches at the Stadium of Light and is nicknamed "The Black Cats."
questions.funFact: They currently sit 19th in the table on 8 points after 10 matches played.

questions.question: Who is Sunderland’s manager?
questions.clue: A French tactician who previously managed Ligue 1 club FC Lorient.
questions.funFact: The French coach took charge in June 2024 and famously guided the club back to the Premier League and into European football.

questions.question: What shirt number did Thierry Henry wear for the majority of his Arsenal career?
questions.clue: An even double-digit number equal to seven multiplied by two.
questions.funFact: He made this squad number iconic at Highbury and the Emirates while becoming Arsenal's all-time leading goalscorer with 228 goals.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles did birthday boy Laurent Blanc win for Manchester United?
questions.clue: The single-digit number representing a solitary championship triumph.
questions.funFact: He lifted the trophy in the 2002–03 season before retiring from professional football.

questions.question: Who is Tottenham’s top scorer so far this season?
questions.clue: A towering Dutch center-back who moved to North London from Brighton.
questions.funFact: Despite playing in defense, his aerial dominance from set pieces has made him Tottenham's surprise leading marksman this term.

questions.question: Who is the youngest player to ever appear in a Premier League match?
questions.clue: An exciting Hale End academy graduate who broke Harvey Elliott's previous record while still a schoolboy.
questions.funFact: He set the all-time record in September 2022 when he came on as a substitute for Arsenal against Brentford aged just 15 years and 181 days.
